steps: Combine all dry-rub ingredients in a lidded bowl or food bag.

steps: Combine softened butter, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.

steps: Pat dry and pound the thick ends level. Coat with oil and all measured seasonings; cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Already prepared this way? Start with preheating.

Loosely tent with foil and rest 5 minutes. Slice across the grain.
